Student Intern - HHSIAN
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
Tech & Data Program Summer 2027 – Data Engineer Intern
Program Overview
At The Hartford, we foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where every voice is valued and every idea can make an impact. Our culture is built on integrity, innovation, and a customer-first mindset. We believe in empowering employees to grow through continuous learning, mentorship, meaningful work, and opportunities to contribute to solutions that support our customers and business.
As a
Data Engineer Intern
, you will help build and support the data pipelines, platforms, and processes that enable analytics, reporting, automation, and AI-driven insights across the organization. This role is ideal for students who are interested in building the systems behind the data — transforming raw information into reliable, usable data assets that help teams make better decisions.
Bring your curiosity, technical mindset, and willingness to learn. Your voice and perspective matter here.
About The Experience
The Hartford’s
Technology, Data, AI, and Operations
organization offers an immersive summer internship program designed to help students explore career paths in technology, data engineering, cybersecurity, AI, analytics, data science, and technology operations within the insurance industry.
As part of The Hartford’s growing investment in AI and advanced analytics, interns will explore how emerging technologies — including generative AI, machine learning, and automation — are transforming business operations, decision-making, and customer experience.
In this role, you will gain hands-on experience supporting data solutions that help power business insights, analytics products, and future AI capabilities.
This role is a hybrid position in Columbus, OH. Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship now or in the future.
What You'll Gain
Hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting data pipelines and data workflows
Exposure to modern data engineering practices, including ETL/ELT, data transformation, data quality, and cloud-based data platforms
Opportunities to work with tools and technologies such as Python, SQL, PL/SQL, Snowflake, GitHub, and cloud platforms
Exposure to how data engineering enables analytics, reporting, automation, machine learning, and AI use cases
Mentorship, coaching, feedback, and self-directed learning opportunities
Networking, volunteerism, and employee engagement experiences with peers and leaders across the organization
A stronger understanding of how data supports decision-making within the insurance industry
Ways You'll Learn, Grow, and Contribute
Depending on your role and project assignments, your experience may include:
Build and support data pipelines that ingest, transform, and prepare data for business and analytical use
Work with structured and unstructured data to enable analytics, reporting, and AI-driven solutions
Apply data engineering tools and techniques (e.g., Python, SQL, ETL processes, cloud technologies) to develop reliable data assets
Ensure data quality, consistency, and performance through profiling, validation, and monitoring activities
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data solutions that address business needs
Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to enhance productivity and support the development of data solutions that power advanced analytics and machine learning
Required Qualifications
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
Strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
Curiosity and willingness to explore new technologies and challenge assumptions
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex problems using structured thinking and logical reasoning
Commitment to ethical judgment, responsible data use, and understanding how technology decisions affect stakeholders and the business
Experience and exposure to some or all of the following:
Programming & Querying: Python, SQL, PL/SQL
Data Engineering: ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data transformation, data profiling, data quality, data modeling
Data Platforms & Tools: Snowflake, GitHub, relational databases, data warehouse concepts
Cloud Technologies: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Analytics & BI: Tableau, dashboards, reporting, data mining, or business intelligence tools
AI & Emerging Technology: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI tools, LLMs, NLP, or interest in building data foundations that support AI-driven solutions
Agile Ways of Working: Exposure to Agile teams, sprint delivery, or collaborative product-based work
Our internship program is designed as a pipeline for future full-time opportunities. High-performing interns may be considered for full-time roles within The Hartford’s Technology & Data organization.
Compensation
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. description_preview:
PURPOSE
The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines and infrastructure that power Baker Group's Microsoft Fabric data warehouse, serving as the organization's single source of truth. This role owns the ingestion, transformation, and orchestration of data from disparate internal systems (ERP, HRIS, MRP and other structured data sources) into governed, reliable data products used by Data Analysts and developers to deliver insights to executive and operational teams and ensures that data is structured to support both traditional reporting and emerging AI and machine learning use cases. The Data Engineer curates and maintains core datasets spanning employees, finance, construction and manufacturing projects, and service, and partners with the Data Scientist, Data Analyst, and Software Development roles to ensure data is trustworthy, well-structured, and fit for downstream use.
Essential Functions And Responsibilities
The following duties are typical for this job. These are not to be constructed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.
Designs, builds, and maintains ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from enterprise systems into Microsoft Fabric.
Architects and maintains the Fabric medallion Lakehouse structure (bronze, silver, gold layers) as Baker Group's single source of truth.
Develop and implement best practices for the data infrastructure and environment (e.g. Development/Test/Production environments, Git for version control).
Owns pipeline orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate data availability.
Curates and maintains core datasets across employee, finance, project, service, and manufacturing domains.
Establishes and enforces data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes across all pipelines.
Designs and manages data models, schemas, and semantic layers that support Data Analyst reporting and Data Scientist modeling work.
Defines and maintains data ontologies and canonical business definitions (for example, what constitutes a "project," "employee," or "cost code") to ensure consistent meaning across systems and consumers.
Prepares and structures data to support AI and machine learning use cases, including feature-ready datasets, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and vector embedding storage.
Manages Fabric capacity planning, workspace organization, and performance optimization.
Implements data governance practices, including access controls, lineage tracking, and metadata management, consistent with Baker Group's data classification standards.
Partners with business system owners (ERP, HRIS, MRP, etc.) to understand upstream data structures and manage change impacts.
Collaborates with the Data Scientist to ensure pipeline outputs support analytical and machine learning use cases.
Collaborates with Data Analysts to ensure data products support paginated reporting, dashboards, and self-service BI needs.
Collaborates with Software Development and DevOps Teams to ensure data products support application development needs.
Coordinates with 3rd party consultants when necessary to deliver data engineering projects and augment capacity for demanding business needs.
Develops and maintains documentation for pipelines, schemas, and integration logic.
Troubleshoots and resolves pipeline failures, latency issues, and data quality incidents.
Monitors and maintains data-specific infrastructure, including Fabric capacity, pipeline orchestration tools, and monitoring/alerting systems.
Evaluates and recommends new data engineering tools, patterns, and best practices.
Stays current on emerging trends in data engineering, cloud data platforms, and integration techniques.
MINIMUM EDUCATION And EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other relevant quantitative field
Three to five years of experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or a related field
Proficiency with SQL and database technologies for data extraction, transformation, and loading
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud ETL/orchestration tools
Experience with medallion architecture and modern data warehousing patterns
Experience with a programming language such as Python, PySpark, or T-SQL for data transformation
Familiarity with data modeling techniques (dimensional modeling, star schema)
Understanding of data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices
Experience preparing data for AI/ML consumption (e.g., vector embeddings, RAG architectures) is a plus
Business acumen and understanding of construction or related industries is a plus
CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS
No specific requirements; however, relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or similar cloud platform certifications are a plus
Mental And Physical Competencies Required To Perform Essential Functions
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex pipeline and data quality issues
Excellent time and project management skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple pipeline and infrastructure projects
Current with industry trends in data engineering, cloud platforms, and integration best practices
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical data structures for non-technical stakeholders
Team player with strong collaboration skills, particularly with the Data Scientist, Data Analysts, and business system owners
Must be able to focus on complex technical problems and work independently with minimal supervision
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities
Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to producing reliable, well-documented data infrastructure
ENVIRONMENTAL ADAPTABILITY
Prolonged pe

The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.
KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Associate in Technology for our Consulting practice.
Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable Salesforce solutions, with a focus on Health Cloud features such as care plans, clinical data models, and provider/patient relationship management, and configure Health Cloud data models including Patient, Provider, Care Team, and Clinical Data
Build Apex classes, triggers, LWC (Lightning Web Components), and Flows to meet business requirements, and participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities using CI/CD pipelines
Design and configure Agentforce agents, topics, instructions, actions, and escalation paths using Agentforce Builder, Flow, Apex, and APIs, and develop and test Prompt Builder templates and grounded AI experiences using Salesforce data, Data Cloud, knowledge, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns
Implement agent testing, evaluation, observability, and guardrails, including accuracy, hallucination risk, data access, human-in-the-loop controls, and production monitoring
Integrate Salesforce with external systems (e.g., Epic, Genesys, MuleSoft, HL7/FHIR APIs) using REST/SOAP web services, and ensure compliance with HIPAA, HITRUST, and other healthcare data security regulations
Collaborate with business analysts, administrators, and architects to translate requirements into technical solutions, and contribute to Salesforce release management, performance tuning, and environment strategy
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment
Qualifications
Minimum of three years of Salesforce development experience with hands-on expertise in Apex, SOQL, SOSL, LWC, Aura Components, Flows, and Triggers
Bachelor's degree from an accredited College or University is required; Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I and Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist are required. Platform Developer II, Health Cloud Accredited Professional, Data Cloud Consultant, or Agentforce Life Sciences Consultant are preferred
Strong understanding of Salesforce Health Cloud data model and features, and experience integrating Salesforce with external systems (HL7/FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations preferred)
Proficiency in Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Streaming), and experience with Version Control (Git), CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.)
Hands-on proficiency with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, generative AI concepts, and responsible AI delivery is required; experience with Data Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud is strongly preferred
Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance (HIPAA, PHI/PII handling), and experience with Salesforce Shield, Event Monitoring, Data Masking, OmniStudio (OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors), enterprise AI/ML services or external models, Agile/Scrum methodologies, strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills preferred
Travel as required to support client engagements, team collaboration, and business development activities

KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.
This position offers a hybrid work option. Nelnet values flexibility and understands the importance of work-life integration. Our hybrid work environment allows associates within 30 miles of an office to work remotely for part of the week, while also fostering collaboration and team connection through in-office presence.
Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship as security clearance is required.

We are FACTS Financial Aid Management, and just like our parent company, Nelnet, we are dedicated to diversification and growth. We are people driven. As opportunities arise to diversify and apply our customer service and software expertise, we look to develop our associates to grow right alongside the company.
We move fast, stay curious, and value fresh ideas. At FACTS, you won’t just keep up with change - you’ll help shape it. And because we’re only as good as our people, we make sure our teams have the support and opportunities they need to thrive.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering and other internal teams to better understand customer needs in order to create new products and product features that will enhance and evolve FACTS Financial Aid Management solutions.  You will also mentor less experienced engineers and give guidance on adherence to best practices and development/quality standards. This will include engaging with resources that are located across the globe. While we work in a .NET stack with Angular, we value engineering fundamentals, passion and the ability to learn over specific tech experience.

Coach and mentor other team members.
Stay positive and solution-oriented with team members and stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of related experience.
.NET stack with Angular experience preferred.
AI experience is preferred.
COMPETENCIES – SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:
Strong technical competency, with a logical, analytical, and creative approach to problem-solving.
Ability to communicate clearly with clients, colleagues, and management on complex issues.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities.

description_preview:
Position Description
Are you driven by technology’s ability to transform how organizations deliver meaningful impact? Do you enjoy solving problems, exploring how software is built, and collaborating with others to bring ideas to life?
If so, CGI offers a place where you can grow your career, build your skills, and make a real impact from day one.
As a Software Developer Intern, you’ll work with cross‑functional teams to support the design, development, testing, and enhancement of technology solutions. You’ll gain exposure to modern development practices and AI‑enabled workflows while building strong foundations in programming, problem‑solving, communication, and responsible use of emerging technologies.
Fall Application Period - August 24, 2026 - October 2, 2026
Your future duties and responsibilities
How You’ll Make an Impact
Develop an understanding of CGI’s industry focus, clients, organizational structure, and business objectives.
Build trusted relationships by asking thoughtful questions, actively listening, and clearly communicating ideas.
Collaborate with clients and cross‑functional teams to translate business and technical needs into organized, actionable inputs.
Assist in designing, developing, and testing software features using programming languages, frameworks, and tools appropriate to project needs.
Support troubleshooting, debugging, and issue resolution to help ensure solutions are reliable and meet business and technical requirements.
Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including designs, code comments, test cases, and project deliverables.
Use modern and AI‑enabled development tools to support coding, research, documentation, testing, debugging, and solution development.
Apply responsible AI practices with appropriate human oversight to ensure attention to privacy, accuracy, security, and quality when using AI‑enabled tools.
Participate in meetings, workshops, testing sessions, and project discussions to support solution development and delivery.
Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role
What You’ll Bring
Current enrollment as a third‑year student in a bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Authorization to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future employer sponsorship. Certain positions may also require U.S. Citizenship and/or the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance based on client or government requirements.
Curiosity, professionalism, and a strong desire to learn about software development and technology‑enabled problem‑solving.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with comfort navigating ambiguity and complex information.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify and explain complex ideas.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with cross functional teams.
Exposure to at least one programming or scripting language and familiarity with general technology concepts through coursework or personal learning (preferred but not required).
Interest in learning and responsibly using modern and AI‑enabled development tools, frameworks, and emerging technologies.
What You’ll Gain
Hands‑on industry experience with a global consulting leader.
Opportunities to contribute to project work and support meaningful client outcomes.
Exposure to modern development practices, collaborative solution design, and technology‑enabled workflows.
Mentorship, coaching, and constructive feedback from experienced CGI professionals.
The chance to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world software development environment and explore future career paths at CGI.
We’re a global company of owners. Over 90,000 partners strong, we bring our diverse backgrounds and perspectives together to solve some of IT and business consulting’s toughest problems for some of the world’s best companies. Looking for a place that empowers you to explore your full potential and shape your own career? The scale and reach of our impact offer you just that. Join a team of great people, collaborate on meaningful work, and serve the communities you call home while you do it.
CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set level, experience and training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit-based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $20.00 - $30.00.
#CGIEarlyCareers
Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Job Title: AWS DevOps Engineer
Company:
Clinisol Tech Inc.
Employment Type:
Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)
Experience:
3–4 years
Compensation:
$65,000 – $90,000 per year
Work Mode:
On-Site / Hybrid
Work Authorization
At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Why This Role?
Modern businesses run on cloud infrastructure — and DevOps engineers who can automate, scale, secure, and optimize AWS environments are in high demand. Build expertise in cloud automation, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and Kubernetes while working on real-world client environments and modern cloud transformation initiatives.
Job Summary
Clinisol Tech Inc. is looking for a hands-on
AWS DevOps Engineer
to support cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and production operations across client environments.
The ideal candidate will have practical experience building and maintaining
AWS infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, containerized applications, and automated deployment processes
. You will work closely with development, cloud, security, and operations teams to improve application delivery, reliability, scalability, and security.
This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who enjoys
automation, troubleshooting, cloud infrastructure, and continuous improvement
.
Key Responsibilities
AWS Cloud & Infrastructure
Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS infrastructure across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Work with AWS services including
EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB, ECR, ECS and/or EKS
.
Support highly available, scalable, and secure cloud environments.
Assist with cloud migrations and modernization of existing infrastructure.
Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain reusable infrastructure using
Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation
.
Create Terraform modules and follow Infrastructure as Code best practices.
Automate repetitive infrastructure and operational tasks using
Python, Bash, or Shell scripting
.
Manage configuration and environment-specific deployments through version-controlled code.
CI/CD & Release Automation
Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for application build, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
Work with one or more CI/CD platforms such as
Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild, or similar tools
.
Implement automated deployment strategies across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot failed builds, deployments, and release issues.
Support rollback and release-management processes.
Containers & Kubernetes
Build and manage containerized applications using
Docker
.
Deploy and manage applications using
Kubernetes, preferably AWS EKS
, and/or Amazon ECS.
Work with Kubernetes resources, deployments, services, ingress, namespaces, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.
Use
Helm
or similar tools for application deployment and configuration.
Exposure to
GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux
is a plus.
Monitoring, Observability & Reliability
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance tracking for cloud and application environments.
Work with tools such as
AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK/Elastic, or similar platforms
.
Troubleshoot infrastructure, application, deployment, networking, and performance issues.
Participate in production support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and preventive-action activities.
Security & Cost Optimization
Implement AWS security best practices involving
IAM, least-privilege access, security groups, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, and secure deployments
.
Integrate security and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
Monitor AWS resource utilization and identify opportunities for
cost and performance optimization
.
Follow organizational security, compliance, and cloud governance standards.
Collaboration
Work closely with developers, QA, architects, security teams, and operations teams.
Participate in code reviews, infrastructure reviews, deployment planning, and technical discussions.
Document infrastructure, deployment procedures, troubleshooting steps, and operational processes.
Qualifications
3+ years of hands-on experience
in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or SRE roles.
Strong hands-on experience with
AWS
.
Experience with
Terraform and/or CloudFormation
for Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience building and managing
CI/CD pipelines
.
Experience with
Docker and Kubernetes/EKS and/or ECS
.
Strong
Linux/Unix
administration and troubleshooting skills.
Strong scripting/automation experience using
Python, Bash, or Shell
.
Good understanding of
Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket
and source-code management.
Strong understanding of
AWS networking
, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, routing, and DNS.
Understanding of AWS
IAM and cloud security fundamentals
.
Experience troubleshooting production infrastructure and deployment issues.
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Tools & Technologies You Will Use
AWS Cloud Services:
EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, ECS, EKS, VPC, Route53, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC):
Terraform, AWS CloudFormation.
CI/CD & Automation:
Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, GitHub Actions.
Containerization & Orchestration:
Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm.
Monitoring, Logging & Observability:
AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Prometheus, Grafana.
Scripting & Configuration Management:
Python, Bash, Shell Scripting, Ansible.
Version Control & Collaboration:
Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence.
Security & Compliance:
AWS KMS, AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, SonarQube, IAM policies.
Preferred Skills
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.
Experience implementing
GitOps

Job Description
Join the Mechanism team within the Space Vehicle Systems Test group at BAE Systems Space and Mission Systems (SMS). We are a group of motivated problem solvers committed to the critical missions we enable. We offer growth opportunities at all levels of skill and experience and are seeking leaders and innovators who can maintain our reputation for technical excellence while helping define the future of BAE Systems SMS.
Make a difference. Love what you do. Realize your full potential.
We are seeking an action-oriented engineer with intellectual curiosity who is excited to challenge themselves by testing spaceflight hardware. This position focuses on testing the flight mechanisms for both Payload and Space Vehicle programs. Responsibilities include writing test procedures, executing tests, performing hands-on work with hardware in a cleanroom environment, and managing various other test engineering duties. The role also requires writing software scripts to support test execution and interacting with Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and automated testing tools.

Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.
At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.
This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.

Job Introduction
If you want your code to matter the moment a customer asks for a quote, this is that role. Our team builds and runs the backend services behind personal lines underwriting and pricing — the APIs and rules engines that evaluates a customer's information and turns it into a risk decision (Accept, Reject, or Pause). You'll work in Java and Spring Boot on event-driven microservices, own your services end to end from design through production support, and help modernize a platform that's actively moving from monoliths to microservices. You'll also have room to grow — mentoring teammates, shaping technical direction, and using modern AI-assisted development tooling to work more effectively.
The USRM Auto Product Tech organization is looking to fill a
Backend Software Engineer
role. Candidate will be at the forefront of API development, focusing on designing, implementing, and modifying RESTful and event-driven APIs that integrate seamlessly with our platform components. Your role will also include mentoring junior team members, share your knowledge and best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the team.

Design, build, and support event-driven microservices in Java and Spring Boot, including REST API design, versioning, and contract management.
Contribute to a large, versioned business rules library, extending underwriting and rating logic while preserving backward compatibility for existing consumers.
Own service quality end to end: unit and integration testing to team coverage gates, static analysis, code review, and production monitoring and incident response.

About ThirdAI Automation
ThirdAI Automation builds the Causal Intelligence Platform for semiconductor manufacturing. Our causal engine and shared knowledge graph pinpoint why a tool, process or defect failed — not just that something changed — cutting root-cause analysis cycle time by 80%+ in production deployments. We sell to semiconductor equipment makers, OSATs and fabs.
The Role
You are the technical presence in front of our customers — running demos, designing and executing POCs, building integrations, and taking pilots into production. You will bring what you learn in the field back into the roadmap. You will work closely with the leadership, engineering and the AI team, with broad autonomy and real influence on what we build next. We are open on level: this is a role where two to three years of the right hands-on experience counts as much as ten.
What You Will Do
Pre-Sales & Technical Evangelism
•    Support the technical sales cycle for enterprise accounts: discovery, requirements mapping, live demos, POC design and proposal writing — owning it end to end as you ramp
•    Deliver product demonstrations tailored to process and equipment engineers, data scientists, and executive buyers
•    Build and maintain ROI models, competitive battlecards and technical comparison material against incumbent analytics tools and in-house builds
•    Represent ThirdAI at industry conferences and ecosystem events (SEMICON, APC/AEC and similar)
Deployment & Customer Engineering
•    Run pilot deployments — data onboarding, model validation and expert sign-off
•    Design integration architectures connecting the platform to enterprise data sources: equipment and tool logs, MES, SPC and metrology systems, historians, and ticketing systems such as Jira, SAP or ServiceNow
•    Build and run evaluation frameworks: A/B studies, expert win-rate assessments, and MTTR / cycle-time benchmarks
•    Support the transition from pilot to production across on-prem, hybrid and air-gapped environments
•    Prepare and run business reviews with accounts to track KPIs, surface expansion opportunities and support renewals
Product Feedback & Roadmap Influence
•    Act as the voice of the field: translate deployment observations into prioritized product requirements
•    Co-author PRDs and integration guides with the engineering team
•    Identify patterns across accounts that point to platform improvements and packaging decisions
Technical Content
•    Produce technical white papers, anonymized case studies and solution briefs documenting deployment outcomes
•    Develop RFP response templates and reusable technical collateral for recurring scenarios
What We Are Looking For
Must-Have
•    Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field
•    2+ years in a technical customer-facing role — solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, consulting or deployment engineering — in enterprise software or AI/ML
•    Hands-on with Python and data: works in notebooks, interprets model outputs and debugs data pipelines on site
•    Comfortable in front of customers — can hold a technical conversation with a process engineer and stay clear in front of their leadership
•    Curious and self-directed: happy owning an unfamiliar problem in a customer environment with limited hand-holding
•    Willing to travel 30–40% to customer sites (US domestic, occasional international)
Strong Plus
•    Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing, process control, equipment engineering or fab operations
•    Familiarity with yield management, SPC or MES platforms
•    Background in causal AI, anomaly detection or predictive maintenance
•    Experience deploying software into operationally critical or regulated enterprise environments
•    Startup experience owning a broad mandate with limited resources
•    On-prem or air-gapped deployment experience (Linux, VMware, Kubernetes)
•    Track record of winning competitive POCs
Why This Role Is Different
•    High autonomy and direct leadership access — your work shapes both customer outcomes and product direction
•    Customer-facing scope most engineers your level never get: live accounts, executive rooms, conference talks
•    You will learn causal AI and semiconductor manufacturing at the same time, from the people building both
•    Room to grow into senior solutions engineering leadership as the team scales
